description: Audit every UniProt protein carrying GO:0019086 and classify by protein family to test whether D15 is a category outlier
code:
import requests, re, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os
pd.set_option("display.width",250); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",70)
outdir="/agent/jobs/0cf15093-9d08-4baf-925b-56add648ad8e/provenance"

# ---- full, paginated UniProt set carrying GO:0019086 ----
url="https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search"
params={"query":"go:0019086","fields":"accession,protein_name,organism_name,length","format":"json","size":500}
rows=[]; r=requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=120); total=r.headers.get("x-total-results")
while True:
    j=r.json()
    for e in j.get("results",[]):
        pdsc=e.get("proteinDescription",{})
        nm=pdsc.get("recommendedName",{}).get("fullName",{}).get("value") or \
           (pdsc.get("submissionNames") or [{}])[0].get("fullName",{}).get("value") or ""
        rows.append(dict(acc=e["primaryAccession"], name=nm,
                         org=e["organism"]["scientificName"], length=e["sequence"]["length"]))
    nxt=r.links.get("next",{}).get("url")
    if not nxt: break
    r=requests.get(nxt, timeout=120)
G=pd.DataFrame(rows).drop_duplicates("acc")
print(f"UniProt entries with GO:0019086 'late viral transcription': {len(G)} (header total {total})")

def cls(n):
    n=n.lower()
    if "nuclease" in n or "flap" in n: return "nuclease"
    if "sigma" in n or "rna polymerase" in n: return "RNAP sigma factor / RNAP subunit"
    if "coactivator" in n or "transcription factor" in n or "stimulatory factor" in n or "cyclin" in n: return "transcription factor / coactivator"
    if "mon1" in n: return "host vesicle-trafficking (MON1)"
    return "other"
G["class"]=G.name.apply(cls)
tab=G["class"].value_counts()
print("\n=== what kind of protein normally carries this term ===")
print(tab.to_string())
print("\n=== every nuclease in the set ===")
print(G[G["class"]=="nuclease"][["acc","name","org","length"]].to_string(index=False))

# evidence codes for P06229 on this term
qg=requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/annotation/search",
    params={"geneProductId":"UniProtKB:P06229","goId":"GO:0019086"},
    headers={"Accept":"application/json"}, timeout=60).json()
print("\n=== QuickGO annotations: P06229 x GO:0019086 ===")
for a in qg.get("results",[]):
    print(" ", a.get("goId"), "|", a.get("goName"), "| evidence", a.get("goEvidence"),
          "| ref", a.get("reference"), "| from", a.get("assignedBy"), "| withFrom", a.get("withFrom"))
print("total:", qg.get("numberOfHits"))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.2,3.4))
order=tab.sort_values()
cols=["#E45756" if i=="nuclease" else "#4C78A8" for i in order.index]
ax.barh(range(len(order)), order.values, color=cols)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(order))); ax.set_yticklabels(order.index, fontsize=9)
for i,v in enumerate(order.values): ax.text(v+max(order.values)*0.01, i, str(v), va="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("UniProt entries annotated with GO:0019086")
ax.set_title("P06229 (T5 flap endonuclease) is the only nuclease carrying 'late viral transcription'")
for sp in ["right","top"]: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

G.to_csv(f"{outdir}/GO_0019086_annotation_audit.csv", index=False)
print("\nsaved:", f"{outdir}/GO_0019086_annotation_audit.csv")
